summary_text: In April 2026, the user placed 13 independent orders, predominantly on weekdays (8) and afternoons (6). The basket composition is heavily anchored by Vegetables, which appeared in every order. Milk and Curd Yogurt were also frequent companions to vegetables, appearing in 10 and 9 orders respectively. Diapers appeared in 4 orders. Other categories like Aerated Drinks, Savouries Namkeens, and Baby Cereal appeared in multiple orders but less consistently. No category combinations were abandoned across independent dates.

Milk and Curd Yogurt are frequent co-purchases with Vegetables, suggesting a stable dairy-produce pairing.

shopping_need_text: The user has a consistent need for fresh produce (Vegetables) and dairy staples (Milk, Curd Yogurt). There is an intermittent need for baby care items (Diapers, Baby Cereal) and occasional purchases of beverages (Aerated Drinks) and snacks (Savouries Namkeens).
